approval_no_answer: Without an answer the request is denied.
approval_invalid_message: {user} answered the request of {agent} (“{device}”: {action}) but may not approve it. The request was denied.
approval_bell_message: An approval request is waiting for an answer. Open Home-Mandate in the sidebar.
approval_test_message: Test from Home-Mandate: approval requests reach this device. Nothing to do here.
page_invalid_request: The agent's request is invalid. Please start the connection in the agent again.
page_invalid_client: The agent could not be identified, or its return address is not allowed.
page_session_expired: The sign-in has expired. Please start the connection in the agent again.
page_signin_failed: Signing in with Home Assistant failed.
page_not_admin: Only Home Assistant administrators may admit agents.
page_busy: Too many sign-ins are in progress. Please try again in a few minutes.
page_consent_claimed: The agent calls itself “{name}”. This is its own claim.
page_consent_unverified: Identifier given by the agent, not checked: {client}
page_consent_return: After your decision you return to {host}.
page_consent_no_templates: There is no mandate template yet. Create one first.
page_consent_invalid: Please enter a name without control characters (at most 80 characters) and choose a mandate.
page_admitted: The agent has been admitted. You can close this window.
page_pair_intro: Enter the code your agent shows.
page_pair_invalid: The code is wrong, expired or already used.
page_pair_locked: Too many failed attempts. Please wait ten minutes.
checkpoint_title: Home-Mandate: state of the audit log
checkpoint_message: Audit log up to entry {seq}, digest {digest}. This message is evidence of the state of the log; please keep it. Log {log}.
rename_flood_message: Home Assistant renamed {count} devices in the last hour. That hints at a broken integration. Home-Mandate processes all of them; rules on the former names keep applying until you decide.
template_read_only_description: May read the state of every device, but switches nothing.
template_light_climate_description: May read everything, switch and dim lights, set temperatures and move covers such as blinds. Garage doors and gates are not included.
template_voice_cautious_description: May read everything, switch lights and set temperatures. Opens locks only after you confirm it on your phone; never cameras or disarming the alarm.
page_consent_approvers_hint: Approval requests of this mandate go to these people. The mandate keeps this list: approvers set up later are not added.
page_consent_nobody: Nobody can answer approval requests of this mandate yet – set up an approver first (Settings → Approvers in Home-Mandate). Until then, every action that needs approval is denied. You can admit the agent anyway.
page_consent_nobody_critical: Nobody can answer approval requests for critical actions of this mandate yet (such as unlocking a door) – set up an approver with a device for critical requests first. Until then, they are denied. You can admit the agent anyway.
page_consent_reach_unknown: Could not check whether anyone can answer approval requests: Home Assistant did not answer. You can admit the agent anyway.
page_reconnect_intro: These agents signed in with the same client before and have had no access since (for example after an emergency stop). If this is one of them, reconnect it: it keeps its entry, its mandate and its history, and gets new access. Several assistants can use the same client, so only choose one if you are sure it is the same. If unsure, admit a new agent above.
page_reconnect_invalid: Choose one of the agents listed to reconnect. The list may have changed: it shows only agents of this client without access.
page_reconnected: The agent is reconnected to its existing entry. You can close this window.
page_reconnect_unverified: This request comes from {address}. It used a pairing code, so these agents match only by the name the agent gave itself, which any agent can give. Reconnect only if you are sure this request really comes from that agent.
